newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal seen $2.00 to $3.00 higher on exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal seen $2.00 to $3.00 higher on exports.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were expected to open $2.00 to $3.00 per ton higher on solid weekly export sales, traders said.
"Those sales were at least 100,000 (tonnes) more than the people I talked to were expecting," said one trader.
USDA put weekly soymeal sales at 209,800 tonnes. That figure was above trade expectations for 80,000 to 150,000 tonnes.
Soyoil futures were seen 0.10 to 0.15 cent per lb higher, mostly on strength borrowed from the other soy markets, traders said.
